rules: Strict left alignment for all typography to maintain an editorial, authoritative stance.
Never center-align headings or body text.
Use extremely tight tracking (tracking-tighter) for massive headings.
Muted text should use text-zinc-400 or text-zinc-500 for secondary hierarchy.
No large gradients. Keep the background deep void black.
The accent color (Electric Blue #3B82F6) should be used minimally, e.g., for tiny hover states, a single animated dot, or small typographic highlights.
Use 1px border-white/10 for subtle separation where necessary, rather than solid blocks of gray.
Pure #000000 is allowed for deepest contrast, but #050505 is the base.

layouts.global: Container with massive padding, e.g., px-6 md:px-12 lg:px-24.
layouts.sections: Vertical spacing must be extreme: py-24 md:py-32 lg:py-48 between major sections.
layouts.hero: Two-column grid on large screens. Left: Kinetic typography. Right: 3D/Abstract subtle visual.
layouts.about: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-12. Portrait takes 4 columns, intro takes 8 columns.
layouts.selected_work: Editorial grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-x-8 gap-y-24. No cards, just raw image and text below.
layouts.skills: Categorized minimalist lists. No progress bars. Use CSS grid for listing skills strictly.
layouts.contact: Massive minimal CTA. Two columns: Form on one side, raw contact info (Email/Location) on the other.

visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-none or extremely minimal rounded-sm (2px). Keep it sharp and brutalist/editorial.
visual_enhancers.textures: Include a subtle SVG noise overlay fixed across the whole screen to give a cinematic, grainy film look (opacity-20).
visual_enhancers.overlay: If text is over an image, use bg-black/40.

motion.scrolling: MANDATORY: Use lenis (or @studio-freight/react-lenis) for premium smooth scrolling.
motion.hero_reveal: Signature masked text reveal: overflow-hidden wrapper, motion.div y: '100%' -> 0 with a slow ease-out (e.g., [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1]).
motion.scroll_reveal: Framer Motion whileInView fade-up (opacity: 0, y: 30) -> (opacity: 1, y: 0) with viewport={{ once: true, margin: '-100px' }}.
motion.hover_effects: Project image hover: group-hover scale-105 duration-700 ease-out on the image. Arrow icon translates right and up (translate-x-2 -translate-y-2).
motion.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee for a slow, editorial ribbon separating sections. Pale text on dark background.

components.Navbar: Sticky fixed top, w-full, z-50. backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60. 1px border-b border-white/10. Logo left, Links center/right, 'Let's Talk' button (sharp corners, border border-white hover:bg-white hover:text-black transition-colors).
components.Hero: Full height min-h-screen flex items-center. Staggered H1 reveal.
components.ProjectItem: No background card. Image container with overflow-hidden aspect-[4/3] or aspect-[3/4]. Image scales on hover. Text sits below: Title (H4), Category (text-sm text-zinc-500).
components.ProjectDetailModal: Use Shadcn Dialog but customize heavily: remove background/padding to make it an edge-to-edge cinematic overlay, or build a custom full-screen Framer Motion modal.
components.StatsRow: Flex or Grid with border-l border-white/20 pl-4. Huge number (text-4xl), small label (text-xs).
components.Marquee: Large uppercase text 'CREATIVE DESIGN • MOTION GRAPHICS • INTERACTIVE MEDIA', font-serif or Space Grotesk, text-transparent bg-clip-text border-text (stroke effect if possible, or just text-zinc-800).

3d_libraries.usage: Use for the Hero section's right side. A subtle, slowly rotating abstract geometric mesh (like an icosahedron or torus knot) with wireframe material or a dark glass shader, illuminated by a very faint blue/purple point light to hit the 'subtle accent' requirement.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure secondary text (#A1A1AA) passes minimum 4.5:1 ratio against #050505.
accessibility.focus: focus:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-white for interactive elements.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for all framer-motion reveals.
accessibility.testid: Add data-testid to all links, buttons, and form inputs.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: framer-motion, @studio-freight/react-lenis, lucide-react, react-fast-marquee, @react-three/fiber, @react-three/drei.
Do NOT use HTML <input> or <textarea> directly for the contact form; use Shadcn UI Input/Textarea components but strip them of generic styling (make them flat, border-b only, dark background).
Implement Lenis smooth scrolling globally in the main layout.
For the Hero section, build the 'masked line-by-line reveal' strictly using Framer Motion with overflow-hidden on each line's wrapper.
Keep standard Awwwards style: Massive type, large high-quality edge-to-edge images, no rounded standard 'cards', sharp edges.
Make sure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts. Keep text left-aligned.
Do not use generic SaaS gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for the sticky nav.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, custom cursors, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Never use placeholder images; use the provided Unsplash/Pexels URLs.
